title: shadows-on-the-cave-wall: code, pre-registered declarations and measured tables for "Shadows on the Cave Wall: What Attention Says About Extraction Errors Is Mostly Geometry"
description: Code, pre-registered declarations and measured tables (without corpus text) for the article "Shadows on the Cave Wall: What Attention Says About Extraction Errors Is Mostly Geometry". Every verdict, number, table and figure of the article is regenerated from this archive by a single command and compared byte for byte with the published version. The fine-tuned weights are archived separately, each with a content fingerprint checked by tools/impressao_digital.py. Version 2 adds the BERT extractors, the BC5CDR corpus, the control windows, the error taxonomy and the prediction declared for BC5CDR (declarations decl-14 to decl-26).  The article was first deposited under the working title "Attention Is Not Not Geometry".
